won_reason: Strong ROI case + champion advocacy from Priya

calls.notes: Discovery call with Priya. Core pain: manual route reconciliation taking 3 hrs/day per dispatcher, 12 dispatchers total. She estimated $180K/year in wasted labor. Budget pre-approved up to $75K. CEO sign-off needed above $50K.

Demo tailored to logistics workflow. Priya brought 2 dispatchers — they loved the real-time tracking module. Built live ROI calculator on the call: 3 hrs x 12 dispatchers x $18/hr x 250 days = $162K savings vs $62K cost. Priya said she will champion internally.

CEO Vikram joined. Priya had already briefed him with our ROI numbers. He asked two sharp questions: implementation downtime risk and data security. We had both answers ready. He asked for a 1-page exec summary, sent within 24 hours.
red_flags: CEO asked about downtime — need to prep case studies

calls.notes: Contract review. Legal had minor MSA edits — liability cap clause. Resolved in 48 hours. Vikram signed. Priya personally messaged saying she pushed hard for us internally.

lessons_learned: Pre-calculated ROI before call 2 = deal accelerator
Priya as champion did the internal selling for us
CEO arriving prepared (briefed by champion) = fast close
24-hour turnaround on exec summary builds trust
Having downtime + security answers ready = no stall at CEO level
